row.title: Tenant repo creation needs a credential the workflow actually holds
row.body: TENANT-REPO-1: tenant-repos.yml had only ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN and LANE_PAT (both unbound), so ultrastable/unlearn was never created; it also word-split jq rows with a for-loop. Third route added: the lane GitHub App minting an installation-wide token with administration and contents write (lane_credential.py org-token); rows are read with while-read.

title: Tenant repo creation needs a credential the workflow actually holds
